creator: MoErgo
title: Advanced Layout Example
notes:
This is an advanced example layout demonstrating the use of macros, combos, hold taps and other advanced features to support:
- Home-row modifiers (HRM)
- Autoshift
- Symbol, Cursor and Gaming Layers
- Basic Mouse emulation
- Combo keys

Note on Mouse emulation:
Mouse emulation requires firmware version v25.01, and HID_POINTING needs to be enabled under Advanced Configuration.
If you're using Glove80 firmware with mouse emulation for the first time, you'll need to unpair it from all host computers and re-pair it.

This layout (TailorKey Zero v4.1) is developed by @moosy. Further information is available on https://sites.google.com/view/keyboards/glove80_tailorkey
TailorKey is inspired by the fully featured Glorious Engrammer, developed by @sunaku. Please see https://github.com/sunaku/glove80-keymaps/releases for the Glorious Engrammer layout.

TIP: Want to use only a part of this layout (like Home-row mods or Autoshift)? Just copy that specific layer, and the associated macros and hold-tap actions will come along automatically. 
See how it's done here:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m72eTAEUWho

holdTaps.name: &AS_HT_v2_TKZ
holdTaps.description:
AutoShift Helper - &AS main macro is chained to &AS_HT hold tap and &AS_Shifted macro. For faster typists, it is recommended to decrease the tapping-term-ms value. A suggested value is 135 ms.
More: https://github.com/nickcoutsos/keymap-editor/wiki/Autoshift-using-ZMK-behaviors
